limitations: Engineering reproducibility only. Replay is not an additional independent scientific source, independent course case, authenticated blind trial, route acceptance or human acceptance.
Exposed single screenshot and caller visual testimony; bright-organic label has no independently verified non-path semantic truth. Comparable finite channels preserve ambiguity only.
Moving short origins are analytically consecutive but are not a bit-exact partition of the long bilinear sample lattice. Existing strict peak selection and numerical seams remain.
Each short itself averages16 samples; all five finite fits cannot establish per-position or same-physical-edge continuity.
Widths40/48/56 are explicit diagnostic arguments, not measured/calibrated widths; raw learner48 does not override its short5 null.
Source/crop match is bounded to this unchanged request/tolerance. It does not establish universal crop or geometric identity.
Null or missing pairing is not proof of physical ribbon absence. Failed strict+6 residuals do not resolve which edge was selected; unavailable comparisons remain UNKNOWN.
No AA benefit, alpha/renderer identity, endpoint ownership, physical scale, general classifier, production default, P6 fresh-geometry disclosure or protected-branch changes.
